Mapbox commit download returned HTTP 404. The public v3.32.0 tag source and npm 3.32.0 declarations were inspected; Mapbox source citations use the pinned release tag. Confirm the supplied commit before replacing tag citations.
MapLibre style-spec 26.4.4 is the exact dependency recorded in maplibre-gl 6.13.0 package-lock.json, not an arbitrary latest style schema.

The TypeScript checker resolves inherited properties and union alternatives against published renderer declarations. A transported schema field is inventoried without claiming wrapper or cross-platform runtime parity.
CSSProperties is resolved with the selected @types/react 19.3.0 host baseline and csstype 3.2.3; host style fields serve Map, Marker, and Popup without duplicating every CSS field three times.

The distinct /mapbox-legacy entrypoint is recorded as composition through the selected stable Mapbox 3 adapter. Legacy Mapbox 1/2 compatibility is outside this current-stable release baseline; this is a project version boundary, not an SDK feature limitation.

Wrapper MapRef declarations include renderer fields that createRef does not copy at runtime. Such declaration-only fields are flagged for investigation rather than represented as working forwarded properties.

Private/underscore renderer implementation members are excluded. Underscore declarations exposed by wrapper type aliases need audit for accidental public leakage; SDK ownership escapes cannot substitute for assigned common features.

Renderer source/control/handler object members are included because getSource, getStyle, map handlers, and control refs can expose them. Host DOM methods are retained as host-specific typed extension paths, not portable native operations.

Overloads share a coverage entry. Upstream APIs retain their signatures in the pinned declaration/source links; inventory presence does not validate default values, return timing, event ordering, or option interactions.

Primitive and tuple/array type-alternative prototype methods are excluded from field enumeration: ordinary JavaScript string/array operations are not independent mapping SDK features. Named coordinate/option aliases remain inventoried, including SDK class methods when the alias includes a class alternative.
